description: "Marguerite; or, The Isle of Demons and Other Poems" by George Martin is a collection of poetry written in the late 19th century. The poems reflect a deep engagement with Canadian themes, history, and landscape, focusing particularly on the romantic narrative of Marguerite and her trials.
